title: Design: A/R Collection after Expand all matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in this report at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • Make sure customer A, first in name order, has an overdue invoice, an unused credit memo, a phone number and a credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.
  • Open the design picture "Expand all from the header" (ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Scroll down a little and look at the Totals row.
  3. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every customer group opens and the header chevron points down.
  • Compared with the picture: the header row shows the chevron, then the columns in the picture's order, letter for letter: "Date" (with a small up arrow), "Location", "Transaction Type", "ID", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance".
  • Customer A's group row shows a blue chevron pointing down, the name in bold with its count in brackets, then in grey "Phone: " and the number and "Credit term: " and the term, on one line.
  • Each of its document rows shows the date, location, transaction type, number (a blue link for the invoice, plain text for the credit memo), due date, days past due, amount.
  • The open balance in bold.
  • The subtotal row under the group reads "Total for " and the customer's name, with the Amount and Open Balance sums in bold.

Step 2:

  • The bold Totals row stays at the bottom of the table while the rows scroll under it.

Step 3:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
  • S7-R10: “A/R credit memos and deposits show as plain text: they have no page of their own.”
  • S2-R1, A/R Collection columns: “A/R Collection: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png: figure "Expand all from the header" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection: date and customer only" (Production (before)), board "7. Filters and call list" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "One chevron in the top-left header cell: "Collapse all" while any group is open, "Expand all" when none is. Group toggles use the same chevron. S4-R1 to S4-R5, S4-R8." (caption of "Expand all from the header")
  • "Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows." (caption of "A/R Collection: date and customer only")

Difference from the PRD (DD-06), closed: PRD version 5 said A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 4): Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as the design shows; PRD version 9 adds S2-R4a and writes S2-R1 in Title Case. The design's version is now the requirement and this case follows PRD version 9; D-81 (C715563), held until then, is now a normal design case.
